headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Audit covered 963 pages across 2 documentation sites (developer.gitbook.com, gitbook.com/docs) for a single product. 36 confirmed broken internal links exist, all within user-facing docs. 156 additional links could not be verified due to authentication or rate-limiting. API reference coverage is 66.67% across 189 detected API pages. Retrieval readiness scores 34.99/100 (weak band), driven by 5.19% chunkability and 4.26% answerability, indicating poor AI/search performance. Example code detection returned 0% reliability, flagged as a likely detection limitation due to JavaScript rendering. SEO/geo issues affect 29.39% of pages, and only 52.79% of 646 key claims include supporting evidence.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

priority_actions.title: Fix all 36 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing docs
priority_actions.why_this_first: Immediate trust and SEO win; broken links directly block user journeys and signal neglect to search engines and prospects.

priority_actions.title: Restructure content to improve chunkability from 5.19% to >70% by adding semantic headings, shorter sections, and explicit topic boundaries
priority_actions.why_this_first: Unlocks AI assistant and RAG ingestion for 963 pages, directly improving discoverability and reducing support load as users find answers autonomously.

priority_actions.title: Consolidate documentation from 2 domains into a single canonical site to eliminate discoverability and consistency risks
priority_actions.why_this_first: Reduces user confusion, consolidates SEO authority, and simplifies maintenance, directly improving trial-to-paid conversion and support efficiency.

strengths: Full crawl coverage achieved: 100% of 1,523 in-scope pages crawled
All pages are citationable (100% citationability), enabling attribution in AI answers
76.32% of pages include last-updated metadata, supporting freshness signals
risks: 36 broken internal links in user-facing docs damage trust, SEO authority, and user journey completion
156 unverified links create uncertainty; actual broken link count may be higher if auth/rate-limit issues mask real failures
Retrieval readiness overall score of 34.99/100 (weak) severely limits discoverability in AI assistants, chatbots, and semantic search
Chunkability at 5.19% and answerability at 4.26% indicate content structure is incompatible with modern RAG and LLM ingestion pipelines
limitations: External audit cannot verify content accuracy, correctness of code examples, or alignment with actual product behavior
Example reliability at 0% is likely a detection limitation due to JavaScript-rendered code blocks; manual sampling required to confirm true example coverage
156 unverified links may include false negatives if authentication, rate-limiting, or server-side blocking prevented verification
automation_first: Deploy CI/CD link checker to catch broken internal links before publish; 36 confirmed broken links exist today, and preventing future breakage saves trust and SEO equity with zero ongoing manual effort.

Implement automated content structure linter to enforce semantic heading hierarchy and section length limits, targeting the 5.19% chunkability score; this will ensure all new and updated pages are RAG-ready and discoverable in AI tools without manual review.

Set up weekly automated crawl with authenticated session to verify the 156 currently unverified links, flagging new failures in Slack; this converts a one-time manual audit into continuous monitoring, preventing silent link rot on high-value integration and API pages.
